usedFor: Membrain holds sales projects, and Google Drive shares a file when “New Sales Project Created” runs “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sales Project Created” in Membrain, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new sales project can send a proposal folder link to the people who need it.

watchOut: Membrain triggers are polling, and “Opportunity Is Updated” fires on every update, so shares can repeat.
